## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 22 specifics

- Located 96.4% (19.5% by fuzzy match), label + body 90.2%, analysis 73.2% (re-run 25 Sep with the fixes of brief §27).
- No typed witness covers this book.
- **From PDF p. 920 to the end, the index is one page ahead of the scan**: each page's headwords are on the page before (pp. 920–933, e.g. p. 922: 11 of its list on p. 921, 2 on its own). The index's last page (894) implies PDF p. 934, but the PDF has 933 pages: **one printed page is missing from the scan near p. 919**, and its headwords are lost with it. `PAGE_FIX` now reads pp. 920–934 of the index one PDF page back (brief §27): located 95.1% → 96.4%. On p. 919, 11 headwords stay unlocated: they are the missing page's.
- Pp. 171–175 print ညာ where the index writes ဉာ (သဗ္ဗညုတညာဏ…), and pp. 828–837 ာ for ါ (သမ္ပာဒ…): recall misses them, the folds find most (with the folds 90.4%).
- Four more small misfilings (unindexed pp. 169, 184, 253, 894 begin entries of the page before), now in `ID_PAGE_FIX`.
